newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Countrywide HK raises FRCD to US$107 mln.
newsitem.headline: Countrywide HK raises FRCD to US$107 mln.

text.p: The Hong Kong branch of Countrywide Corp has increased its floating rate certificate of deposit issue to US$107 million from US$100 million, arranger Overseas Union Bank said.
The deal is guaranteed by Countrywide Banking Corp.
The facility has a final maturity of three years. The issue was priced at par to float at 10 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 11 basis points.
Arranger Overseas Union Bank committed US$5 million.

Co-arrangers and lead managers with US$15 million each are Banque et Caisse d'Epargne de l'Etate, Luxembourg, Bayerische Vereinsbank Singapore, DKB Asia, Sumitomo Finance Asia and Westpac Banking Corp Hong Kong.
Senior manager Kredietbank Singapore committed US$10 million. Other senior managers with US$6 million each are BNP and Union Bank of Switzerland Hong Kong.
Manager Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz Girozentrale committed US$5 million. --Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2847 4039
